name: Kamiya-ke no Koakuma-san
source:
The protagonist is just your average girl.
When she meets a demon, however,
her daily life begins to be filled with heart-pounding situations!

If she can't fall in love within a month while freeloading off five brothers,
the demon will steal her energy and make her unpopular forever?!

She can go on dates with them, hang out with them after school,
sometimes even visit their rooms.
It's okay if she develops feelings straight away
or if she wants to lead the guy on for a bit.
It might even be okay for her to form a love triangle...?
The endings will change based on the choices you make.

Would you like to live out an exciting romance, with a demon to boot?

[Translated from [url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/5871]Freem![/url]]
translation:
主角只是一个普通的女孩。
然而，当她遇到恶魔时，
她的日常生活开始充满了令人心碎的情景！

如果她不能在一个月内坠入爱河，同时又白吃五个兄弟，
恶魔会偷走她的能量，让她永远不受欢迎？！

她可以和他们约会，放学后和他们一起出去玩，
有时甚至参观他们的房间。
如果她立即产生感情就没关系
或者如果她想引导这个家伙一段时间。
或许，她也可以组成三角恋……？
结局将根据你所做的选择而改变。

你想与恶魔一起过上令人兴奋的浪漫生活吗？

[译自[url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/5871]Freem![/url]]
